evals.name: no-design-system
evals.prompt: I have a React app I've been building for months and the CSS is a complete mess — I have like 6 different shades of blue all hardcoded, the spacing is random everywhere, and I think I have 3 different font sizes for body text. Can you audit my UI and tell me where to start?
evals.expected_output: Structured audit report with a Health Score, at least one CRITICAL finding around hardcoded colors and inconsistent spacing, a priority recommendation list, and a follow-up question asking for constraints before proceeding.

evals.name: partial-system
evals.prompt: We have a partial design system — colors are done but spacing is inconsistent and our button component is missing hover and disabled states. Please audit what we have and propose a plan to finish the system.
evals.expected_output: Audit that correctly identifies good color work, calls out spacing issues as WARNING, and flags missing button states as CRITICAL. Proposal should include token completion plan and before/after button variants.

evals.name: accessibility-check
evals.prompt: My designer picked this color scheme: white text (#ffffff) on a medium blue (#4a90e2) for body copy, and light gray (#f0f0f0) text on white (#ffffff) for secondary labels. Does this pass accessibility standards?
evals.expected_output: Contrast ratio calculations for both pairs, clear WCAG AA/AAA pass/fail status, and specific hex alternatives if a pair fails — without overhauling the whole design.
